nodes.title: The Death of Ghatotkacha
nodes.historical_context: Ghatotkacha wreaks havoc on the Kaurava forces at night. Driven to desperation, Karna uses the infallible Shakti Astra—originally saved for Arjuna—to kill him.

nodes.title: The Final Duel
nodes.historical_context: Karna and Arjuna face off. The curses laid upon Karna manifest simultaneously: his chariot wheel sinks into the earth, and he forgets the mantras for his divine weapons.
